panel.name: blender_connect_tab
panel.text: Start the Blender Connect add-on in Blender, then connect to its preview.glb. Geometry, PBR materials and SL-compatible skin weights update locally. Only you see the preview. No assets are uploaded or added to inventory. Use Select / Move to place it, or attach it to your own avatar.

button.name: connect
button.label: Connect...
button.tool_tip: Opt in to watching one GLB published by the Blender Blender Connect add-on. This connection lasts only for this login session.

button.name: disconnect
button.label: Disconnect / Remove
button.tool_tip: Stop watching and remove the local preview and its materials.

button.name: attach
button.label: Attach to My Avatar
button.tool_tip: Wear the local preview at your chest attachment point. Compatible rigs follow your avatar's skeleton.

check_box.name: joints
check_box.label: Include joint position overrides
check_box.tool_tip: Reload with authored joint positions, for fitted bodies that require them. Off uses the normal upload preview default.

panel.text: Self-contained GLB, up to 32 MiB. Normal mesh / cluster LOD rendering. Custom upload LODs, physics and morph targets are not previewed.
